data.body: Every other AWS CLI failure branch in this loop (`list-layer-versions`, `get-layer-version`, `add-layer-version-permission`, `get-layer-version-policy`) redirects stderr into the captured variable with `2>&1` and echoes it to the log before the `::warning::`/`::error::` annotation, so a maintainer can see why the call failed. The `publish-layer-version` call omits `2>&1`, so on failure `$PUBLISH_RESULT` is empty and only the generic 'Failed to publish the layer in ${REGION}' warning is emitted — the actual AWS error (throttling, an unsupported `--compatible-runtimes java25` value, quota limits, permission issues, etc.) is silently discarded instead of surfacing in the job log. Capture and echo stderr the same way the sibling blocks above it do.
